method: Read the latest decision_key revision for each of 107 semantic failure dossiers and inspected reopening pathways mentioning capacity, eligible occurrences, source evidence, or independent binding. I retained only a condition whose wording could let recurrence/capacity stand in for a new semantic owner.

nominations.material_issue: The reuse_original_signature_model pathway says reopening can be supported by an independently supported donor/relation OR a new eligible occurrence. A new eligible occurrence by itself is only added exposure/capacity; it does not independently bind pcheey to a dry referent or to an input/source relation. This disjunct could incorrectly reopen the dry-source assignment after recurrence under the same authored DRY/MOIST and role labels.

exact_source_evidence.quote: pcheey hat nur drei reader-exakte Vorkommen. Alle drei stehen unmittelbar rechts von einer feuchten Präparationsform.
Damit ist die sparsamste portable Bedeutung: pcheey = Trockenzubereitungs-/Form-II-Eintrag; Identität offen.

nominations.why_existing_evidence_is_insufficient: The source reports three same-frame occurrences and explicitly leaves identity open. Recounting that frame, even with adequate capacity, cannot supply the missing dry-property and source/result relation bindings. The dossier's own question and shared limits correctly require those bindings, so the unqualified occurrence disjunct is internally overbroad.
nominations.one_actionable_correction: Change the requirement to: ‘Identify a changed independently supported donor/relation or a newly independently source-bound occurrence whose referent/property and relation are fixed before scoring.’ State that a new occurrence without such binding is capacity only and cannot reopen the historical dry-source assignment. Keep all other pathway gates unchanged.
nominations.decision_consequence: Prevents a recurrence-only result from being treated as a semantic reopening; preserves the current neutral record-field outcome until a source-owned contrast exists.

screen_conclusion: No other latest dossier inspected showed a comparable false disjunct: the remaining capacity/coverage conditions either explicitly require independent binding or explicitly say capacity is not target-score or meaning evidence. This is a review nomination, not an authorization or registry mutation.
